crew.definition:
n. the men and women who man a vehicle (ship, aircraft, etc.)
n. the team of men manning a racing shell
v. serve as a crew member on
crew.translation:
n. 全体人员, 一群人, 全体队员
crow的过去式

crew chief.translation: n. 地勤组长（部队军衔）

crew-neck.translation:
adj. crew neck（水手领汗衫；水手领）的变形
 水手领（紧贴脖颈底部的无衣领的领口）

crew-served.translation: adj. [军事]数人操作的，班组操作的；协同操作的

crewcuts.translation: (crewcut 的第三人称 -s形式) n. 平头发式

crewe.translation: n. 克鲁郡（英格兰城镇）

crewed.definition: v serve as a crew member on
crewed.translation: vt. 当工作人员（crew的过去式与过去分词形式）

crewel.definition: n. Worsted yarn,, slackly twisted, used for embroidery.
crewel.translation: n. 双线, 刺绣用细绒线

crewels.translation: [医] 淋巴结结核, 瘰疬

crewelwork.definition: n. embroidery done with loosely twisted worsted yarn

crewing.definition: v serve as a crew member on
crewing.translation: vt. 当（尤指船上的）工作人员（crew的现在分词形式）

crewman.definition:
n. a member of a flight crew
n. a member of a work crew

crewmate.translation: n. 同船工作之船员, 同机工作的机员

crewmates.translation: (crewmate 的复数) n.同船工作之船员, 同机工作的机员

crewmember.translation: n. 组员；船员水手；工作班人员

crewmembers.translation: (crewmember 的复数) n. 组员；船员水手；工作班人员

crewmen.definition:
n any member of a ship's crew
n a member of a flight crew
n a member of a work crew

crews.definition:
n the men and women who man a vehicle (ship, aircraft, etc.)
n an organized group of workmen
n an informal body of friends
n the team of men manning a racing shell
v serve as a crew member on
crews.translation: n. 一起工作的人, 一群做同一工作的人
